title: UCC 1-308 Explained: A Guide to Legally Opting Out of the System
summary: Role-play showing how to assert a UCC 1-308 reservation of rights at a traffic stop, with a template offered on Patreon.

assertions.quote: write UCC 1-308 next to your signature All Rights Reserved
I cannot sign any documents that could be construed as a contract without full disclosure and agreement
good evening officer I do not answer questions am I being detained or am I free to go

verdicts.note: The right to silence covers questions, but drivers must still produce license and registration and in many states identify themselves.
